rules.condition: Spouse ATC II016 (Mixed Income - 8% IT Rate) is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: If spouse type Compensation Earner is not selected, the official UI sets Item 52B to 0.00 and disables it.
rules.rejected_behavior: When spouse type Compensation Earner is selected, the source condition is false and Item 52B remains enabled even though the guide says the P250,000 reduction is not applicable to mixed-income earners.
rules.official_behavior: The spouse mixed-income reduction is disabled only when optSpouseType_3 is false, which is inverted for the normal compensation-earner mixed-income case.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: For ATC II016, force Item 52B to zero and disabled regardless of the spouse-type radio; flag contradictory spouse-type/ATC combinations separately.

rules.condition: Taxpayer type changes from Estate/Trust to Single Proprietor/Professional after disableSpouse() has run.
rules.accepted_behavior: Other spouse background controls are re-enabled by enableSpouse().
rules.rejected_behavior: Item 23 remains disabled because enableSpouse() targets taxpayer Item 14 instead of the spouse control.
rules.official_behavior: enableSpouse() enables txtForeignTaxNumber rather than txtSpouseForeignTaxNum. The Edit path does enable Item 23, so behavior depends on transition path.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Enable spouse Item 23 with the other spouse fields; do not mutate taxpayer Item 14 as a side effect.

rules.condition: Spouse name is nonempty, graduated tax rate is selected, and neither spouse Item 25A method is selected.
rules.accepted_behavior: Official Validate has no Item 25A check and can report success after prior checks pass.
rules.rejected_behavior: No rejection occurs; Item 41B treats the blank method as OSD through its else branch.
rules.official_behavior: Spouse Item 25A is not validated. Blank computes as OSD although the guide deems an unmarked choice Itemized.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Apply the guide default of Itemized or require an explicit choice; never silently treat blank as OSD.

rules.condition: Edit is clicked after successful validation and taxpayer/spouse tax-rate or deduction-method selections differ.
rules.accepted_behavior: Spouse Schedule I/II fields happen to match when taxpayer and spouse selections are the same.
rules.rejected_behavior: enableAllControl() uses taxpayer rate/method controls to enable spouse Schedule I/II fields, producing the wrong spouse edit state.
rules.official_behavior: Spouse Schedule I checks optTaxRate_1 and optMethodOfDeduction:_1; spouse Schedule II checks optTaxRate_2, all taxpayer controls.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Derive each spouse schedule field from spouse tax-rate and spouse deduction-method selections.
unresolved_questions: Live Edit-state confirmation is pending because computer-use cannot initialize.

rules.condition: Edit is clicked after successful validation while spouse name is empty.
rules.accepted_behavior: Computed spouse totals remain disabled, and Item 59B is separately disabled when no spouse is present.
rules.rejected_behavior: Other spouse credits/payments and penalty inputs are unconditionally re-enabled even though no spouse exists.
rules.official_behavior: enableAllControl() enables both A and B inputs for noncomputed Items 55-68 without checking spouse presence; only Item 59B is corrected later.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Keep all spouse-column credit/payment and penalty inputs disabled unless a spouse filing branch is active.

rules.condition: Taxpayer and spouse use different schedules and either party tax-rate transition runs.
rules.accepted_behavior: The shared description happens to match the most recently processed party schedule.
rules.rejected_behavior: Enabling one party schedule disables the shared description for the other party schedule, although both schedules remain in use.
rules.official_behavior: enableSchedule1/2 and disableSchedule1/2 mutate single shared txt43Desc/txt48Desc controls without considering the other party.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Enable each shared description when either party uses its schedule; disable only when neither party uses it.
